decision: Variant A (4 pineapples) is recommended. It has significantly faster completion times (mean 5.73s vs 8.93s, p=0.0006), a significantly higher completion rate (89.0% vs 70.8%, p=0.0000), and a significantly higher repeat rate (53.6% vs 40.2%, p=0.0081). Variant B is worse on all metrics, likely because the extra pineapple increases difficulty. Ship Variant A.

metrics.label: Completion Time
metrics.context: Lower is better. Variant A completions are 35.9% faster. Welch t-test p=0.0006.

metrics.label: Completion Rate
metrics.context: Higher is better. Chi-squared test p=0.0000.

metrics.label: Effect Size
metrics.context: Small-to-medium negative effect. Variant B increases completion time by ~0.4 standard deviations.

methodology: Welch's t-test for completion time difference (unequal variances). Chi-squared test for completion rate. Two-proportion z-test for repeat rate. Sample Ratio Mismatch (SRM) check passed (p=0.16). Each puzzle_completed event treated as a separate observation. No CUPED or regression adjustment applied.
